blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model's existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model's existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.
blocks.zh: 连续的预训(CPT)被广泛用于使预训语言模型适应方言和非标准语言品种,然而仍然不清楚何时需要这种附加培训,是什么推动了其好处,以及综合评价得分是否充分把握其效果. 在本文中,我们介绍了对魁北克省欧洲防止酷刑委员会法语理解的受控研究,涉及9个涉及不同家庭和尺度的法学硕士课程。 我们的结果显示,利用每个实验3000兆令牌的预算匹配协议,CPT的好处在很大程度上取决于起始模型在目标种类方面的现有能力。 当CPT有益时,改进更多是由实体组成而不是由数据量驱动的,其中文学文本占了大部分收益. Paired Québec和法国标准评价进一步表明,欧洲防止酷刑委员会主要改进表达理解而不是语法能力,而且实体登记册决定了获得哪些区域表达。 这些收益还涉及具体能力的权衡,包括读取总分可以掩盖的理解下降。 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,不应将欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚用于方言的调整视为一个统一有利的缺省。 相反,适应战略应首先仔细评估基准模型的现有能力,同时进行源一级数据分析和任务一级评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are pretrained on massive corpora to support a wide range of applications, including summarization, natural language and code generation, and open-domain dialogue. Despite their capabilities, LLMs often perform better on the standard form of a language than on its regional varieties. This phenomenon, known as the dialect gap ( Kantharuban et al., 2023 ) , persists even in multilingual models trained on large and diverse corpora ( Jaech and others, 2026 ; Comanici and others, 2025 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) : when a dialect is underrepresented in the training data, its linguistic capabilities are often reduced in the resulting LLM.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在巨型公司上进行预训,以支持广泛的应用,包括归纳,自然语言和代码生成,以及开放域对话. 尽管LLMS具有其能力,但在一种语言的标准形式上往往比在区域品种上表现更好. 这种现象被称为方言差距(Kantharuban等人,2023年),甚至在接受过大型多样的方言(Jaech等人,2026年;Comanici等人,2025年;Lin等人,2024年)培训数据中代表不足的多语种模式中依然存在:当某一方言在培训数据中代表不足时,其语言能力往往在由此产生的LLM中下降.

blocks.en: Continual pre-training (CPT) ( Ke et al., 2023 ) is widely used to address dialectal adaptation. By taking an existing model pretrained on the standard language and continuing its training on dialectal text, CPT aims to improve regional language competency while preserving the broad capabilities learned during pre-training ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ; Sarkar et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 连续预训(CPT)(Ke等人,2023年)被广泛用于解决方言适应问题. 欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚委员会接受标准语言培训的现有模式,并继续接受方言文本培训,目的是提高区域语言能力,同时保留在培训前学到的广泛能力(Gururangan等人,2020年;Sarkar等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: However, this approach leaves several questions unresolved: 1) Base models can differ substantially in their existing competence in the target variety, making adaptation unnecessary for models that already perform well; 2) dialectal corpora are often small and heterogeneous, combining a variety of genres and registers. Unless the amount of training data is controlled, it is difficult to determine whether performance changes are caused by specific genres and registers or by greater volume of texts; and 3) aggregate benchmark scores may not be sufficiently representative of the gains (or degradation) of an LLM’s capabilities in specific tasks. We isolate three factors that are usually confounded in dialectal adaptation studies: the base model’s existing competence, the composition of the adaptation corpus, and the granularity of evaluation. We focus on Québec French, for which paired dialectal and standard French benchmarks targeting the same capabilities are available, which makes this isolation possible. Our evaluation is restricted to language understanding; whether CPT changes the dialectal character of generated text is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 然而,这一办法留下了几个尚未解决的问题: 1) 基础模型在目标品种方面的现有能力可以有很大不同,因此对于已经表现良好的模型来说没有必要进行适应;2) 方言公司通常规模小,种类繁多,结合了各种流派和登记册. 除非培训数据的数量得到控制,否则很难确定性能变化是由具体的流派和登记册或更多的文本造成的;和 3)总的基准分数可能不足以代表一个LLM在特定任务中的能力的增益(或退化)。 我们孤立了通常在方言适应研究中感到困惑的三个因素:基础模型的现有能力、适应体的组成和评价的颗粒性。 我们把重点放在魁北克法语上,为此,有针对相同能力的法语方言和标准基准对齐,从而使这种孤立成为可能。 我们的评价仅限于语言理解;CPT是否改变生成文本的方言特性留待未来工作.

blocks.en: To investigate these research questions, we conduct a controlled, budget-matched study of CPT for Québec French. Our evaluation spans nine LLMs from three model families (0.5B to 14B parameters), with each experiment utilizing exactly 30M training tokens. This uniform constraint not only enables direct comparisons between various corpus compositions, but also mirrors the realistic data scarcity inherent to low-resource dialectal adaptation, where clean, target-variety text is often difficult to obtain. We compare every adapted model with its own unadapted baseline. Evaluation pairs each Québec French benchmark with a standard French benchmark measuring the same linguistic capability, drawn from the COLE suite ( Beauchemin et al., 2025 ) , alongside standard French retention tasks and held-out perplexity scores.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些研究问题,我们对魁北克法语的欧洲防止酷刑委员会进行了有控制、预算相称的研究。 我们的评价涵盖三个模范家庭的9个法学硕士(0.5B到14B参数),每个实验完全使用30M培训符号。 这种统一的制约不仅能够直接比较各种实体构成,而且反映了资源低的方言适应所固有的现实数据稀缺性,在这种情况下,往往难以获得干净、目标模糊的文字。 我们把每个经过改造的模型 与它自己的未经改造的基线进行比较 从COLE套套装(Beauchemin等人,2025年)中抽取的每个魁北克法语基准与标准法语基准并列,

blocks.en: Together, our findings suggest that, in the low-resource regime where dialectal adaptation is typically performed, CPT should not be treated as the default response to dialect under-representation. Under a limited adaptation budget, the impact of CPT depends on the starting model, the composition of the adaptation corpus, and trade-offs among individual capabilities that aggregate scores and perplexity may fail to reveal. Specifically, our contributions in this work are: • We show that the benefit of dialectal CPT for comprehension depends strongly on the base model’s existing competence in the target variety, and that informal-only adaptation degrades regional expression comprehension in eight of nine models. • We show that corpus composition matters more than data volume, with gains driven primarily by literary text on CroissantLLM, the model that gains most from CPT. • We show that aggregate evaluation scores and held-out perplexity provide an incomplete evaluation of CPT: task-level evaluation reveals large and opposing capability changes, including losses in reading comprehension, that remain hidden behind aggregate performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,在通常进行方言调整的低资源制度下,不应将欧洲防止酷刑委员会视为对方言代表性不足的默认反应。 在有限的适应预算中,欧洲防止酷刑委员会的影响取决于起始模式、适应机制的组成以及个人能力之间的权衡,而综合得分和迷惑可能无法揭示。 具体地说,我们在这项工作中的贡献是: 我们表明,方言CPT对理解的好处在很大程度上取决于基准模型在目标种类方面的现有能力,而仅非正式的适应则会降低九个模型中的八个模型的区域表达理解。 我们显示,实体构成比数据量更重要,其收益主要来自CroissantLLM的文学文本,CroissantLLM这一模式从欧洲防止酷刑委员会获得最多。 我们显示,总体评价分数和持有的迷惑性为欧洲防止酷刑委员会提供了不完整的评价:任务一级的评价揭示了巨大的和相反的能力变化,包括阅读理解方面的损失,这些变化仍然隐藏在总体业绩之后。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Continual Pre-Training (CPT)
blocks.zh: 2.1 连续预训

blocks.en: Continual pre-training (CPT) adapts pretrained language models to new domains via self-supervised learning on unlabeled text ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ; Ke et al., 2023 ) . Recent work explores strategies such as multilingual training ( Csaki et al., 2024 ; Fujii et al., 2024 ; Joshi et al., 2025 ) and data replay ( Gupta et al., 2023 ; Ibrahim et al., 2024 ) to improve adaptation while preserving prior knowledge. Crucially, CPT’s efficacy depends heavily on model scale and domain size: small or mismatched adaptation corpora can leave stronger models unchanged or even degrade them ( Reid et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 连续的预训(CPT)通过自我监督的无标签文本学习,将预训语言模型适应新域(Gururangan等人,2020年;Ke等人,2023年). 近期的工作探索了多种语言培训(Csaki等人,2024年;Fujii等人,2024年;Joshi等人,2025年)和数据重播(Gupta等人,2023年;Ibrahim等人,2024年)等战略,以改善适应,同时保留先前的知识。 关键是,CPT的效能在很大程度上取决于模型规模和域大小:小的或不匹配的适应蝎子可以使更强的模型保持不变甚至降解(Reid等人,2022年).

blocks.en: 2.2 Dialectal and Low-Resource Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 糖尿病和低资源适应

blocks.en: Because LLMs perform unevenly on under-represented regional varieties ( Kantharuban et al., 2023 ; Faisal et al., 2024 ) , a standard approach is to adapt existing models rather than train them from scratch. While low-resource adaptation often applies CPT to massive, heterogeneous multilingual corpora ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , dialectal adaptation is distinct because models already possess substantial knowledge of the associated standard language. Prior work employs techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, and synthetic data to bridge these dialect gaps ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Bafna et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) . For Québec French specifically, recent work has demonstrated that adaptation is feasible under strict resource constraints, while highlighting that outcomes remain highly sensitive to corpus composition ( Khan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于LLMs在代表性不足的区域品种上的表现不均匀(Kantharuban等人,2023年;Faisal等人,2024年),因此一种标准方法是调整现有模式,而不是从零开始对其进行培训。 虽然低资源适应常将CPT应用于大规模,多样的多语种corpora(Lin等人,2024年;Ji等人,2024年;Yu等人,2026年),但方言适应却有所不同,因为模型已经对相关标准语言拥有大量知识. 前期工作采用监督微调、LORA和合成数据等技术弥补这些方言差距(Liu等人,2023年;Bafna等人,2025年;Hu等人,2022年)。 特别是就魁北克法语而言,最近的工作表明,在严格的资源制约下,适应是可行的,同时强调,结果对实体构成仍然高度敏感(Khan等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no previous work has systematically isolated the role of base model competence, demonstrated how specific textual genres drive the acquisition of regional expressions rather than grammar, or studied how standard aggregate metrics mask the task-specific capability trade-offs inherent to dialectal continual pre-training.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,以前的任何工作都没有系统地孤立基本示范能力的作用,说明具体的文字流派是如何推动获得区域表达而不是语法的,或研究标准汇总度量法如何掩盖了方言持续预先训练所固有的特定能力权衡。

blocks.en: 3 Corpus and Adaptation
blocks.zh: 3 公司与适应

blocks.en: 3.1 Québec French Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.1 魁北克法语区

blocks.en: To investigate these research questions, we conduct a controlled, budget-matched study of CPT for Québec French. We use the mixed-source Québec French corpus of Khan et al. (2026) which covers multiple genres and registers. Table 1 shows the composition of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些研究问题,我们对魁北克法语的欧洲防止酷刑委员会进行了有控制、预算相称的研究。 我们使用混合来源的魁北克省法语Khan等人教案(2026年),涵盖多个流派和登记册。 表1列示了该实体的组成。

blocks.en: Table 1: Composition of the Mixed-Source Québec French Adaptation Corpus. Token count was computed using the CroissantLLM tokenizer 1 1 1 available at https://huggingface.co/croissantllm . .
blocks.zh: 表1:混合来源魁北克法语适应公司的组成。 Token计数是使用CroissantLLM表示器11计算的,可在https://huggingface.co/croissantllm上查阅。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the complete 86.7M-token corpus is drawn from nine sources categorized into two primary registers. The formal register (52.5M tokens) consists of clean, standardized written language, including public-domain literature ( Bibliothèque Électronique du Québec ), Québec Wikipedia and news articles. Conversely, the informal register (34.2M tokens) captures vernacular language, comprising transcribed speech ( Centre de recherche interuniversitaire sur le français en usage au Québec ) alongside colloquial user-generated web text from regional discussion forums and social media platforms.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,完整的86.7M-托肯案从9个来源抽取,分为两个主要登记册。 正式的注册(52.5M令牌)包括干净,标准化的书面语言,包括公共领域文献(Bibliothèque Électronique du Québec),魁北克维基百科和新闻文章. 相反,非正式登记册(34.2M令牌)收录了当地语言,包括转写语言(魁北克法语使用问题大学间研究中心),以及来自区域讨论论坛和社会媒体平台的由用户制作的口头网络文本。

blocks.zh: 3.2 适应设置

Models are ordered left to right by baseline QFrCoRE. Results are difference in Macro-F1 compared to baseline result, averaged over three seeds.

blocks.en: We perform CPT on nine LLMs across three families to compare adaptation across different architectures and levels of prior French exposure: CroissantLLM (1.35B) ( Faysse et al., 2024 ) , Llama-3.2/3.1 (1B, 3B, 8B) ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B) ( Team, 2024 ) . To ensure a fair comparison and avoid oversampling our smallest informal sources, all experiments are strictly budget-matched to 30M tokens. We adapt all models using LoRA while keeping the base-model weights frozen. Full optimization details, hyperparameters, and checkpoint selection criteria are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们针对三个家庭的9个LLMs进行CPT,以比较不同建筑的适应性以及以前法国接触的水平:CroissantLM(1.35B)(Faysse等人,2024年),Llama-3.2/3.1(1B,3B,8B)(Grattafiori等人,2024年)和Qun2.5(0.5B,1.5B,3B,7B,14B)(Team,2024年). 为了确保公平比较和避免对最小的非正式来源作过多的抽样,所有实验都严格按照3000兆令牌的预算进行。 我们使用LORA来改造所有模型 同时保持基模重量的冻结 附录A提供了全部优化细节、超参数和检查站选择标准。

blocks.en: We evaluate our models on two separate axes: dialect-specific acquisition and standard French retention. To isolate Quebec dialectal competence, we use two benchmarks: QFrBLiMP ( Beauchemin et al., 2026b ) is a grammatical acceptability task consisting of 1,761 sentence pairs, where the model must distinguish a correct sentence from one containing a common grammatical mistake sourced from official Québec guidelines. QFrCoRE ( Beauchemin et al., 2026a ) is a definition-matching task containing 4,633 regional idiomatic multi-word expressions, requiring the model to identify the correct meaning from ten possible candidates.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个独立的轴线来评价我们的模型:方言特定的获取和标准的法国保留. 为了隔离魁北克方言能力,我们使用两个基准: QFrBLIMP(Beauchemin et al., 2026b)是一个语法上可接受的任务,由1,761句对齐组成,其中模型必须区分正确句子和包含来自官方魁北克指南的常见语法错误的句子. QFrCoRE(Beauchemin等人,2026a)是一个定义匹配的任务,包含4,633个区域异构多词表达,要求模型从10个可能的候选者中识别正确的含义.

blocks.en: We pair these with standard French equivalents that target the same linguistic capabilities in order to serve as the standard French control: MultiBLiMP-Fr ( Jumelet et al., 2026 ) is a grammatical acceptability task parallel to QFrBLiMP, consisting of 255 sentence pairs. MFrCoE ( Beauchemin et al., 2026a ) is a definition-matching task parallel to QFrCoRE, containing 4,938 standard French expressions.

blocks.en: In addition, to monitor for standard French forgetting during adaptation, we track performance on four general standard French tasks from the COLE suite ( Beauchemin et al., 2025 ) : AlloCiné ( Blard, 2020 ) is a binary sentiment classification task evaluating a corpus of 20,000 French movie reviews. PAWS-X ( Yang et al., 2019 ) is a paraphrase detection task requiring the model to identify whether two lexically overlapping sentences are semantically equivalent. We used the test set of 2,000 French samples for evaluation. Fr-BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) is a binary reading comprehension task consisting of yes/no questions paired with context passages. We used the French subset of 178 test samples. MMS ( Augustyniak et al., 2023 ) is a sentiment analysis task evaluating text drawn from diverse domains using a binary or trinary classification schema. We used the French subset of 63,190 test samples.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了监控适应期间标准法语忘却的情况,我们从COLE套套装(Beauchemin等人,2025年)中追踪4个通用标准法语任务的表现: AlloCiné(Blard,2020年)是一个二进制情绪分类任务,评价一套2万份法国电影评论. PAWS-X(Yang et al.,2019年)是一种解释性检测任务,要求模型识别两个逻辑上重叠的句子是否等效. 我们用2 000个法国样本的测试组进行评估。 F-BoolQ 乐团 (Clark et al., 2019)是一个二进制读理解任务,由是/否问题与上下文段落对齐组成. 我们用了178个测试样本的法国子集。 管理事务 (Augustynik et al., 2023)是一种情绪分析任务,使用二元或三元分类计划来评价从不同领域提取的文本. 我们使用了63,190个测试样本的法国子集。

blocks.en: is a binary sentiment classification task evaluating a corpus of 20,000 French movie reviews.
blocks.zh: 这是一个二进制情绪分类任务 评估一套 20,000 法国电影评论。

blocks.en: is a paraphrase detection task requiring the model to identify whether two lexically overlapping sentences are semantically equivalent. We used the test set of 2,000 French samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 是一种解释性检测任务,要求模型确定两个逻辑上重叠的句子是否等同。 我们用2 000个法国样本的测试组进行评估。

blocks.en: is a binary reading comprehension task consisting of yes/no questions paired with context passages. We used the French subset of 178 test samples.
blocks.zh: 是一个二进制读取理解任务, 由“是”/“否”问题与上下文段落对齐组成。 我们用了178个测试样本的法国子集。

blocks.en: is a sentiment analysis task evaluating text drawn from diverse domains using a binary or trinary classification schema. We used the French subset of 63,190 test samples.
blocks.zh: 是一种情绪分析任务,使用二进制或三进制的分类方案来评价来自不同领域的文字。 我们使用了63,190个测试样本的法国子集。

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.3 实验设置

blocks.en: To investigate CPT for dialectal adaptation, we designed several experiments along three core dimensions: 1) the impact of corpus composition (see Section 4 ); 2) the impact of base model capacity (see Section 5 ); and 3) the masking effect of aggregate metrics (see Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 为了调查CPT对方言的适应,我们围绕三个核心层面设计了几项实验: 1) 实体构成的影响(见第4节);2) 基本模型能力的影响(见第5节);3) 总体计量的掩盖作用(见第6节)。

blocks.en: Across all experiments, we report macro-F1 scored via length-normalized candidate log-likelihoods, averaged over three random seeds. Additionally, we compute held-out perplexity (PPL) for both language varieties. Unless otherwise noted, all performance changes are measured against each model’s unadapted baseline.
blocks.zh: 在所有实验中,我们报告宏F1通过长度正常的候选对数得到的分数,平均超过三个随机种子。 此外,我们计算两种语言的持有的复杂度。 除非另有说明,所有性能变化都根据每个模型未经调整的基准来衡量。

blocks.en: 4 Impact of Corpus Composition
blocks.zh: 4 公司构成的影响

blocks.en: To evaluate how register and genre influence dialectal acquisition, we run three experiments. The first (see Section 4.1 ) examines the formal-only and informal-only register extremes across all nine LLMs. The second experiment (see Section 4.2 ) varies the formal-to-informal ratio exclusively on CroissantLLM to measure how granular changes in register impact the acquired dialect. Finally, the third experiment (see Section 4.3 ) conducts a leave-one-genre-out ablation relative to the full mixed-source corpus to isolate the contribution of specific genres.
blocks.zh: 为了评价注册和流派如何影响方言获取,我们进行了三个实验. 第一部分(见第4.1节)审查了所有9个法学硕士课程中只登记正式和非正式的极端情况。 第二项实验(见第4.2节)将正式与非正式的比例完全放在CroissantLLM上,以衡量登记册的颗粒变化如何影响获得的方言。 最后,第三次实验(见第4.3节)就完全混合源体进行了一个离子流派的分离,以隔离特定流派的贡献。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the full mixed-source corpus and the variants obtained by reweighting individual sources. To vary the register, we construct five variants ranging from formal-only (100/0) to informal-only (0/100). Within each register, sources are sampled proportionally to their distribution in the full corpus. If a source’s target allocation exceeds its raw availability (e.g., CRIFUQ), we do not artificially cycle the text over multiple epochs. Instead, all available tokens from that source are used exactly once, and the shortfall is backfilled with random sentences sampled from other sources within the same register. This protocol maintains the strict 30M-token budget across all experiments while preventing overfitting to the smallest domains.
blocks.zh: 表2显示通过重新加权单个来源获得的完全混合来源和变体。 为了改变登记册,我们构建了五个变体,从正式的(100/0)到非正式的(0/100)。 在每个登记册中,资料来源按其全部分布情况的比例进行抽样。 如果一个来源的目标分配超过其原始可用性(例如CRIFUQ),我们不会人为地将文本循环到多个时代。 相反,所有来自该来源的现成代号都精确使用过一次,缺额被从同一登记册内其他来源抽取的随机句子回填. 这个协议在所有实验中保持严格的30M-token预算,同时防止过度适应最小的领域.

blocks.en: Table 2: Corpus Variants Used in the Register Sweep. Values represent the allocated token budget (in millions) for each source. Sources within each register are sampled proportionally to their raw availability to maintain exactly 30M tokens per condition.
blocks.zh: 表2:登记册中所用的公司替代物。 数值是每个来源分配的代号预算(以百万计)。 每个登记册内的来源按原始可用量按比例抽样,以保持每个条件的3 000兆令牌。

blocks.en: 4.1 Register Sweep Across all Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 对所有模型的登记扫瞄

blocks.en: Table 3: Continuous Register Sweep on CroissantLLM 1.35B: Results are Macro-F1, averaged over three seeds. Perplexity (PPL) is evaluated on held-out Québec French and standard French sets.
blocks.zh: 表3:CroissantLLM的连续登记册 1.35B:结果为Macro-F1,平均超过3个种子. 在魁北克省被搁置的法语和标准法语套餐中,对迷惑性(PPL)进行评估。

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of register, we first examine the formal-only and informal-only variants across all nine LLMs. Full results are in Appendix B , in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估登记的效果,我们首先审查所有九个有限责任公司中只有正式和非正式的变式。 全部结果载于附录B表5。

blocks.en: As Figure 1 (a) and (b) show, grammatical performance fluctuates minimally, shifting at most 2.0% on QFrBLiMP and 4.8% on MultiBLiMP-Fr. This confirms that dialectal CPT safely preserves underlying syntax regardless of register.
blocks.zh: 如图1(a)和(b)所示,语法性能波动最小,在QFrBLIMP上变化最多为2.0%,在MultiBLIMP-Fr上变化最多为4.8%. 这证实,无论登记与否,方言式的CPT都会安全保留基本的语法.

blocks.en: Expression comprehension, by contrast, is highly sensitive to corpus composition (see Figure 1 (c) and (d)). Formal-only training yields higher QFrCoRE scores across almost all models, averaging a 5.3-point average advantage over informal-only. Conversely, informal training degrades QFrCoRE in eight of nine models, averaging a 4.0% drop, while raising the standard French equivalent, MFrCoE (5.0%), in all nine. Formal training drives the exact opposite shift, primarily in weaker base models.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,表达理解对实体构成高度敏感(见图1(c)和(d))。 几乎所有模式中只有正式培训的QFrCoRE分数都较高,平均比仅非正式培训有5.3分的平均优势。 相反,非正规培训使QFrCoRE在九种模式中的八种模式下降,平均下降4.0%,同时提高标准法语的等价,所有九种模式的MFrCoE(5.0%)。 正规培训驱动着完全相反的转变,主要是在较弱的基础模式中.

blocks.en: Because QFrCoRE and MFrCoE share identical multiple-choice formats, this opposing shift confirms a change in linguistic knowledge rather than mere format learning. This divergence exposes an evaluation trap: if a model trained on informal Québec data is validated on standard French benchmarks, rising scores create a false illusion of success. Instead, our paired evaluation reveals that target dialect comprehension degrades.
blocks.zh: 由于QFrCoRE和MFrCoE共享相同的多选择格式,这种对立的转变证实了语言知识的变化,而不仅仅是格式学习. 这种差异暴露了一种评价陷阱:如果一个接受过非正式魁北克数据培训的模型被验证为标准法国基准,那么提高得分就会产生一种虚假的成功幻想. 相反,我们的对等评价显示,目标方言理解下降。

blocks.en: Table 4: Leave-One-Genre-Out Ablations at fixed budget for CroissantLLM 1.35B. All rows train on the same 30M token budget. Results are the mean of three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表4:CroissantLLM1.35B的固定预算中的1-Genre-Exple-Exple-One-Genre-Explication。 所有列车都使用相同的30M令牌预算. 结果为三种种子的平均值。

blocks.en: 4.2 Continuous Register Sweep on CroissantLLM
blocks.zh: 4.2 对CroissantLLM进行连续登记扫描

blocks.en: To observe the impact of the register across a continuous spectrum, we conduct a register sweep on CroissantLLM 1.35B. We chose this model as our testbed because it shows the largest gain in regional expression comprehension during CPT (see Section 4.1 ). As Table 3 shows, under formal-only training, its QFrCoRE score rises from a 27.5% baseline to 35.7% (+8.2%). This strong capacity to absorb regional knowledge provides the clear signal needed to accurately track how incremental changes in the data mixture affect dialect acquisition.
blocks.zh: 为了不断观察登记册的影响,我们对CroissantLLM 1.35B进行了一次登记册扫描。 我们选择这个模型作为试验台,因为它显示了欧洲防止酷刑委员会区域表达理解的最大收益(见第4.1节)。 如表3所示,在正规培训中,其QFrCoRE分数从基线的27.5%上升到35.7%(+8.2%)。 这种吸收区域知识的强大能力提供了准确跟踪数据混合物的增量变化如何影响方言获取所需的明确信号。

blocks.en: When informal text progressively replaces formal text, this dialectal gain decreases monotonically (35.7% → \to 33.9% → \to 7% → \to 32.2% → \to 28.2%), while grammatical performance (QFrBLiMP) fluctuates in no particular direction. This continuous decline reinforces our broader finding that the target variety’s unique vocabulary is sparse in informal data and significantly better preserved in formal sources.
blocks.zh: 当非正式文本逐渐取代正式文本时,这种方言增益会单调下降(35.7% ~\至33.9% ~\至7% ~32.2% ~\至28.2%),而语法性能(QFrBLIMP)则没有特定方向波动. 这种持续下降加强了我们更广泛的结论,即:在非正式数据中,目标品种的独特词汇很少,在正式来源中保存得更好。

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of register, we verified whether dialectal adaptation relies on specific data curation or simply raw text exposure. If volume were the primary factor, doubling the budget should yield substantial gains. Therefore, we evaluate a 60M-token Mixed Double condition, a 50/50 formal–informal mixture, which reaches a QFrCoRE score of 33.8 % 33.8\% . As shown in Table 3 , this is only 0.1% above the standard 30M-token Mixed (50/50) condition ( 33.7 % 33.7\% ). By comparison, allocating the baseline 30M-token budget entirely to formal text increases QFrCoRE to 35.7 % 35.7\% . Because a targeted 30M-token corpus outperforms the mixed 60M-token corpus, we conclude that data composition matters more than total volume at this scale.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离登记的效果,我们核实了方言适应是依靠具体的数据解析,还是仅仅原始文本曝光. 如果数量是首要因素,预算翻一番应可产生巨大收益。 因此,我们评价一个60M-托肯混合双倍条件,一个50/50的正式-非正式混合,达到QFrCoRE的33.8%的33.8%。 如表3所示,这只比标准30M-托肯混合(50/50)条件(33.7%33.7\%)高0.1%。 相比之下,将基线30M-token预算完全分配给正式文本,将QFrCoRE提高到35.7%的35.7%。 由于一个30M-托骨体超过了60M-托骨体的混合性,因此我们的结论是,数据组成在这个尺度上比总体积更重要。

blocks.en: 4.3 Leave-One-Genre-Out Ablations

Having established that formal text drives the acquisition of regional expressions, we use a leave-one-genre-out ablation to verify which genre aids adaptation the most. When a source is removed, the remaining sources are upsampled to maintain the budget, ensuring any performance change is driven by the absence of that genre’s linguistic characteristics rather than a reduction in data.
blocks.zh: 在确定了正式文本推动获取区域表达方式之后,我们用一个例外的提法来核实哪些流派最有助于适应。 当一个来源被删除时,对其余来源进行抽样,以维持预算,确保任何性能变化都是由于缺乏该流派的语言特征而不是减少数据而驱动的。

blocks.en: As Table 4 shows, literary text is the clear driver of dialectal adaptation. Removing 15.4M tokens of BEQ text drops QFrCoRE from the full-corpus reference of 33.7% to 28.3%, erasing nearly all CPT gains. Conversely, removing the largest individual source, Québec Wikipedia (31.2M tokens), leaves the score unchanged at 33.8%.
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,文学文字是方言适应的明显驱动力. 取消15.4M的BEQ文本令牌将QFrCoRE从全公司参考率33.7%降至28.3%,从而抹去了几乎所有CPT收益. 反之,移除最大的个人来源魁北克维基百科(31.2M令牌),使得得分不变,为33.8%.

blocks.en: Grammatical performance (QFrBLiMP), in contrast, is unchanged, fluctuating by less than a single point (89.5% → \to 90.3%) across all ablations. While the acquisition of new regional expressions is highly sensitive to the genres provided during training, the model’s fundamental syntactic capabilities remain preserved regardless of the mixture. QFrBLiMP specifically evaluates the model’s robustness against common regional syntactic errors and English calques documented by official Québec linguistic guidelines. Its stability demonstrates that CPT injects divergent dialectal expressions without corrupting the model’s pre-existing, shared syntactic foundation.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,语法性能(QFrBLIMP)没有变化,在所有浮点上波动不到一个点(89.5%~~~90.3%). 虽然获得新的区域表达方式对培训期间提供的流派非常敏感,但无论混合型如何,该模型的基本合成能力仍然保留。 QFrBLIMP针对常见的区域综合错误和官方魁北克语言指南所记录的英语卡片,专门评价模型的稳健性. 它的稳定性表明,CPT注入了不同的方言表达方式,而不会腐蚀模型先前存在的共享的合成基础.

blocks.en: Beyond dialectal acquisition, the ablation reveals that corpus composition dictates standard French retention. Removing literary text strengthens the decline in standard French reading comprehension (Fr-BoolQ: 40.5% → \to 35.2%) and degrades standard French perplexity (9.68 → \to 11.73). Conversely, removing informal data spikes AlloCiné by 11.9% (53.1% to 65.0%), suggesting that informal text interferes with pre-existing sentiment capabilities.
blocks.zh: 除了方言学的获得之外,废除法则表明,实体构成决定了标准的法国保留。 删除文学文本加强了标准法语阅读理解的下降(Fr-BoolQ:40.5% →\=35.2%),并降低了标准法语的迷惑度(9.68 →\=11.73)。 相反,消除非正式数据使AlloCiné上升了11.9%(53.1%至65.0%),这表明非正式文本干扰了原有的情绪能力。

blocks.en: The perplexity scores further expose a dissociation between language modeling metrics and downstream capability. Removing literary text yields the best Québec French PPL in the entire suite (15.91 → \to 10.46), yet this condition produces the worst QFrCoRE score (33.7% → \to 28.3%). This inverse relationship confirms that perplexity improvements can be driven by simplifying the held-out distribution rather than by acquiring regional features.
blocks.zh: 迷惑分数进一步暴露了语言建模度量衡和下游能力之间的脱节. 删除的文艺文字在整个套间(15.91 ~\=10.46)产生最好的魁北克法语PPL,然而这个条件却产生最差的QFrCoRE分数(33.7%~\=28.3%). 这种反向关系证实,通过简化搁置分配,而不是通过获得区域特征,可以推动复杂程度的改善。

blocks.en: Overall, the results in Table 4 isolate genre , not register, to demonstrate that composition matters more than raw volume. Because the budget remains controlled, the decline when removing BEQ (33.7% → \to 28.3%) confirms that literary text supplies the regional expressions the benchmark requires, whereas removing Wikipedia, a formal encyclopedic source twice the size of BEQ, leaves performance unchanged. This supports the register-sweep result of Section 4.2 : the benefit of formal-heavy training comes not from formality itself, but from the literary component that formal-heavy mixtures contain more of. We offer a hypothesis: BEQ consists of public-domain Québec literary works, whose older, lexically denser vocabulary makes it the most plausible source of the traditional regional expressions QFrCoRE evaluates, which encyclopedic, news, and modern informal text may rarely contain.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,表4中的结果隔离了流派,而不是登记,以表明组成比原始体积更重要。 由于预算仍受控制,删除BEQ(33.7%~\=28.3%)时的下降证实了文学文本提供了基准要求的区域表达方式,而删除维基百科这个正式的百科全书来源是BEQ的两倍,使得性能保持不变. 这支持了第4.2节的登记-扫描结果:正规-重型训练的好处不在于形式本身,而在于正规-重型混合物中含有更多的文学成分。 我们提出一个假设:BEQ由公共领域魁北克省文学作品组成,其较古老,语言密集的词汇使其成为传统区域表达QFrCoRE评价的最可信来源,其中百科全书、新闻和现代非正式文本可能很少包含。

blocks.en: 5 Impact of Base Model Capability
blocks.zh: 5. 基地模型能力的影响

blocks.en: Having identified formal-only text as the optimal mixture, we investigate whether dialectal adaptation benefits all LLMs equally. To answer this, we apply the same training procedure across nine LLMs, again using a fixed 30M token adaptation budget. This allows us to verify the role of each LLM’s starting competence. Full results are available in Appendix B , in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们确定只有正式文本才是最佳的混合体,调查方言适应是否对所有有限责任公司都有利。 为此,我们在9个有限责任公司实行同样的培训程序,再次使用固定的3 000兆令牌适应预算。 这使得我们能验证每个LLM的初始能力的作用. 全部结果载于附录B表6。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows a divergence between grammatical acceptability and expression comprehension based on a model’s initial competence. Plotting CPT performance against the unadapted baseline reveals that grammatical performance (QFrBLiMP) remains stable. Scores fluctuate by at most 2.0% across all models regardless of size, clustering along the diagonal and confirming that syntactic structures are preserved across the spectrum.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,根据模型的初始能力,语法可接受性和表达理解之间存在差异。 对照未调整基线绘制CPT性能显示语法性能(QFrBLIMP)保持稳定. 在所有模型中,无论大小,分数最多波动2.0%,沿着对角线组合,并证实跨谱的合成结构得到保存。

blocks.en: Regional expression comprehension (QFrCoRE), in contrast, shows an inverse relationship between baseline competence and adaptation gains, where weaker base models benefit the most. The limited 30M-token budget acts as an equalizer, pushing smaller models significantly above the diagonal (+8.2% for CroissantLLM, +1.5% for Qwen 0.5B). Meanwhile, improvements in performance shrink as baseline competence increases, and the two strongest baselines fall below the diagonal (-1.4 for Llama-3.1 8B, -2.2 for Qwen2.5 14B). These results suggest that highly capable models already possess much of the regional knowledge in our corpus, and that a 30M-token signal is too sparse to update their internal representations. Budget-constrained CPT thus effectively bootstraps smaller models, but frontier models likely require larger data volumes or targeted instruction tuning to show measurable dialectal gains.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,区域表达理解(QFrCoRE)表明基线能力与适应收益之间的反关系,其中较弱的基础模型受益最大。 有限的30M-token预算起到均衡作用,推动较小的模型大大高于对角(CroissantLLM+8.2%,Quen 0.5B+1.5%). 同时,随着基线能力提高,性能的改善有所收缩,两个最强基线都低于对角线(Llama-3.1 8B为-1.4,Quen2.5 14B为-2.2)。 这些结果表明,高度有能力的模型已经掌握了我们文书中的大部分区域知识,一个30M的信号太少,无法更新其内部表述。 因此,受预算限制的欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚委员会有效地吸引了较小的模型,但前沿模型可能需要更大的数据量或有针对性的指导调整,以显示可衡量的方言收益。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Impact of Baseline Competence: CPT performance plotted against the unadapted baseline. The diagonal dashed line represents unchanged performance.
blocks.zh: 图2:基线的影响 能力:欧洲防止酷刑委员会根据未经调整的基线规划业绩。 双向折叠线表示未变的性能.

blocks.en: 6 Pitfalls of Aggregate Metrics
blocks.zh: 6 综合计量的陷阱

blocks.en: Finally, to evaluate if aggregate scores conceal forgetting and task-specific trade-offs, we replace a portion of the training budget with standard French replay data from a held-out corpus 1 1 1 available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/croissantllm/croissant_dataset . . This isolates severe, capability-specific regressions and recoveries that would otherwise remain hidden behind stable aggregate averages.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了评价总分是否掩盖了遗忘和特定任务的权衡,我们将培训预算的一部分用标准的法文重播数据取代,这些数据来自一个第11号被搁置的指令集。 这孤立了严重、针对能力的回归和回收,否则这些回归和回收将隐藏在稳定的总平均值之后。

blocks.en: 6.1 Standard French Replay
blocks.zh: 6.1 标准法语重播

blocks.en: While Section 5 showed how base model capability dictates the acquisition of new dialectal knowledge, measuring success solely by these gains ignores the potential capabilities lost in the process. In standard continual learning, adapting a model to a new domain often degrades its prior knowledge, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting ( McCloskey and Cohen, 1989 ; Biesialska et al., 2020 ) . To expose this hidden cost, we allocate a portion of our 30M-token budget (10%, 25%, and 50%) to standard French replay data. Full results are provided in Appendix B , in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 虽然第5节显示,基础模型能力如何决定着如何获得新的方言知识,但仅用这些成果衡量成功却忽视了在这一过程中丧失的潜在能力。 在标准的不断学习中,将模型适应新领域往往会降低其先前的知识,这种现象被称为灾难性的遗忘(McCloskey和Cohen, 1989年; Biesialska 等人, 2020年). 为了揭露这一隐性成本,我们拨出了我们30M-token预算的一部分(10%、25%和50%)用于标准的法国重播数据。 全部结果载于附录B表7。

blocks.en: As Figure 3 shows, evaluating standard French capabilities through a broad aggregate metric makes the replay intervention appear ineffective. Averaging across the four general French benchmarks yields a flat trend line (see the dotted black line), sitting around 3% below the unadapted baseline (41.9%) and hovering around 38.8% regardless of the replay ratio. Relying solely on this macroscopic evaluation would mistakenly lead us to conclude that replay fails to restore any standard French capabilities degraded by dialectal CPT.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,通过粗略的汇总度量法来评价标准法国能力,使得重播干预显得无效. 横跨法国四大基准,形成一条平坦的趋势线(见点状黑线),位于未调整基线(41.9%)下方约3%,无论重播比例如何,徘徊在38.8%左右. 仅仅依靠这个宏观评价会错误地导致我们得出这样的结论:重播无法恢复任何被方言CPT退化的法国标准能力.

blocks.en: Disaggregating these scores, however, reveals opposing capability shifts. As standard French replay increases, performance on reasoning-heavy tasks such as Fr-BoolQ (blue line) recovers monotonically (40.8% → \to 50.1%). However, as Fr-BoolQ improves by 9.3%, the standard French sentiment task AlloCiné degrades by 7.7%. This opposing shift exposes a trade-off under a constrained token budget: re-introducing formal standard French restores logical inference but pulls the model’s distribution away from the colloquial language necessary for domain-specific sentiment tasks.
blocks.zh: 然而,对这些分数进行分列表明能力发生了相反的变化。 随着标准法语重播的增加,在Fr-BoolQ(蓝线)等推理重任务上的性能单调恢复(40.8%~\=50.1%). 然而,随着Fr-BoolQ的改善9.3%,标准法国的情绪任务AlloCiné下降7.7%. 这种对立的转变暴露了在受限制的象征性预算下的一种权衡:重新引入正式的标准法语可以恢复逻辑推论,但将模型的分布从用于特定领域情绪任务的口语中拉开。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, performance on PAWS-X (green line) and MMS (pink line) remains static across all replay ratios. Because these flat scores are averaged with the opposing swings of Fr-BoolQ and AlloCiné, the resulting aggregate metric is artificially stabilized.
blocks.zh: 同时,PAWS-X(绿线)和MMS(平克线)的性能在所有重播比例上保持静态. 由于这些平分的分数与Fr-BoolQ和AlloCiné的对立摆动是平均的,因此所产生的总分量被人为稳定.

blocks.en: Rather than restoring a generic standard French average, replay specifically rehabilitates reading comprehension without erasing dialectal gains, as QFrCoRE holds steady at 33.7%. First, as shown in Figure 4 , standard French PPL strictly improves as replay volume increases (9.62 → \to 8.47), indicating global language modeling gains despite the stable task average. Second, as reported in Table 7 (see Appendix B ), replacing French-only replay with a balanced French-English source at the 25% ratio yields nearly identical Fr-BoolQ performance (48.0% vs. 48.1%). Because CroissantLLM is bilingual, this suggests that the recovery of its logical reasoning capabilities is not strictly tied to standard French exposure, but can be effectively stimulated by generic pre-training text in either of the model’s core languages.
blocks.zh: 与其恢复通用标准的法语平均值,还不如具体恢复阅读理解,而不抹去方言收益,因为QFrCoRE稳定在33.7%。 首先,如图4所示,标准法式PPL随着回放量的增加(9.62 →\===8.47)而严格改进,表明尽管任务平均值稳定,但全球语言模式还是取得了进步. 第二,如表7所报告(见附录B),用平衡的法语和英语源取代仅法国语的重播,其比例为25%,结果几乎相同(48.0%对48.1%)。 由于CroissantLLM是双语的,这说明其逻辑推理能力的恢复并没有严格地与标准的法语曝光挂钩,而是可以通过两种模式核心语言的通用预训文本来有效刺激.

blocks.en: 6.2 Aggregate Metrics Mislead
blocks.zh: 6.2 总体计量误差

blocks.en: The masking effect observed in Section 6.1 exposes an important flaw in aggregate scoring: broad averages conceal severe capability trade-offs forced by replay under a constrained token budget. This masking also occurs during adaptation itself. As noted in Section 4.1 , the formal-only condition improves overall Québec dialect performance while hiding an 18.5% degradation on Fr-BoolQ (56.2% baseline → \to 37.7%).
blocks.zh: 第6.1节所观察到的遮掩效应暴露了总评分中的一个重要缺陷:广义的平均值掩盖了在有限的象征性预算下通过重玩而迫使进行严重的能力权衡。 这种蒙面也发生在适应本身期间. 如第4.1节所述,只有形式上的条件提高了魁北克方言的整体性能,同时在Fr-BoolQ上隐藏了18.5%的降解率(56.2%的基线==37.7%)。

blocks.en: Beyond aggregate averages, held-out perplexity presents a second evaluation trap. When dedicated dialectal benchmarks are unavailable, perplexity is often used as a proxy for adaptation success ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ; Wettig et al., 2024 ) . Our results caution against this substitution. The clearest evidence is the within-model dissociation in the genre ablation (see Table 4 ): the experiment with literary text removed achieves the best (lowest) PPL QC of any CroissantLLM condition (15.91 → \to 10.46) yet yields the worst QFrCoRE score (28.3%).
blocks.zh: 除了总平均数外,被搁置的迷惑性还构成第二个评价陷阱。 当没有专门的方言基准时,迷惑常被用作适应成功的代名词(Gurururangan等人,2020年;Wettig等人,2024年)。 我们的结果告诫不要使用这种替代方法。 最清楚的证据是在流派中模式内脱节(见表4):删除文学文本的实验取得了任何CroissantLLM条件(15.91 ~\to 10.46)中的最佳(最低)PPL QC,然而得出了最差的QFrCoRE得分(28.3%).

blocks.en: Removing lexically dense literary text from the training corpus simplifies the language modeling task, which artificially improves perplexity. However, because this literary text is the primary source of regional vocabulary, removing it erases the model’s ability to comprehend the dialectal expressions measured by the benchmark. While perplexity is not always inversely correlated with downstream performance, this dissociation proves it is an unreliable predictor of dialectal acquisition: a model can achieve "better" perplexity simply by training on standard, predictable text, even as it fails to learn the target dialect.
blocks.zh: 从培训大纲中去除语法密集的文学文字简化了语言建模任务,这人为地提高了模糊性. 然而,由于这个文学文本是区域词汇的主要来源,删除它会抹去模型理解以基准衡量的方言表达的能力. 虽然迷惑性并不总是与下游的性能呈反向联系,但这种离散性证明了它是对方言获取的不可靠的预测:一个模型仅仅通过对标准,可预见文本的训练就可以实现"更好的"迷惑性,即使它未能学习目标方言.

blocks.en: Echoing recent critiques of NLP leaderboards ( Ethayarajh and Jurafsky, 2020 ; Bowman and Dahl, 2021 ) , our findings demonstrate that shortcut metrics, whether aggregate averages or perplexity scores, are insufficient for evaluating dialectal adaptation in a comprehensive way. Validating adaptation requires the disaggregated, per-task reporting adopted throughout this paper.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果与NLP领导板(Ethayarajh and Jurafsky, 2020年;Bowman and Dahl, 2021年)最近的批评一致, 核实适应情况需要在整个本文件中采用按任务分列的报告。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a controlled study of dialectal CPT for Québec French language understanding on nine LLMs from three families. By restricting the training budget to 30M tokens, we demonstrated that the efficacy of adaptation is dictated primarily by a model’s baseline competence rather than the process itself. While our weakest base model gained 8.2 points in regional expression comprehension, stronger models hit a capability ceiling, yielding no benefit, leaving the most capable unadapted models strictly superior to all adapted variants.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了对魁北克省法语方言理解的CPT的受控研究,涉及来自三个家庭的9种语言。 通过将培训预算限制在3 000兆令牌之内,我们表明适应的效果主要取决于模型的基线能力,而不是进程本身。 虽然我们最弱的基础模型在区域表达理解上获得了8.2分,但较强的模型击中了能力上限,没有产生任何好处,使得最有能力的不适应模型严格地优于所有适应变体。

blocks.en: Furthermore, when CPT succeeds, its benefits are narrow: improvements are concentrated in expression comprehension rather than grammar, driven by formal literary text rather than raw volume, and highly sensitive to register. Notably, relying on informal genres actively degraded target dialect comprehension in eight of the nine models. Finally, we exposed the zero-sum nature of these gains in expression comprehension: severe degradations in reading comprehension, which standard French replay recovers but aggregate task averages conceal.
blocks.zh: 此外,当欧洲防止酷刑委员会取得成功时,其好处是有限的:改进集中在表达理解而不是语法上,由正式的文学文本而不是原始的体积所驱动,并且对登记非常敏感。 值得注意的是,在九种模式中的八种模式中,依靠非正式的流派积极降低目标方言的理解。 最后,我们在表达理解中暴露了这些收益的零和性质:读理解中严重退化,标准法语重放后会恢复,但总任务平均值会掩盖。

blocks.en: Additionally, our results caution against using held-out perplexity as a proxy for adaptation success. We reveal a dissociation where simplifying the held-out distribution, such as removing lexically dense literary text, artificially improves perplexity while destroying the model’s acquisition of regional expressions.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的成果告诫不要将搁置的迷惑作为适应成功的代名词。 我们揭示了一种脱节现象,即简化被搁置的分布,例如去掉语法密集的文学文字,人为地提高迷惑性,同时破坏模型获得的区域表达方式。

blocks.en: Ultimately, our findings challenge the assumption that dialectal CPT is a uniformly beneficial default. Effective low-resource adaptation requires assessing the base model’s competence, curating adaptation corpora by genre rather than volume, and favoring disaggregated, task-level evaluation.
blocks.zh: 最终,我们的调查结果对方言CPT是共同有利的默认假设提出质疑。 有效的低资源适应需要评估基准模型的能力,用流派而不是数量来管理适应公司,并赞成分门别类地进行任务一级的评价。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although this study highlights important gaps in the assessment of dialectal adaptation, our empirical scope is limited. Our analysis is restricted to Québec French and relies exclusively on the COLE benchmark suite alongside its standard French counterparts. Consequently, while our methodological critiques regarding aggregate metrics and perplexity are applicable to the Québec French dialect, the specific dynamics we observe, such as the strong impact of literary text, must be validated across other dialects and languages before being generalized.
blocks.zh: 虽然本研究突出了方言适应评估中的重要差距,但我们的经验范围有限. 我们的分析仅限于魁北克法语,并且完全依靠COLE基准套件和法国标准套件。 因此,虽然我们对综合衡量和迷惑性的方法批评适用于魁北克法语方言,但我们观察到的具体动态,如文学文本的强烈影响,必须先在其他方言和语言中验证,然后才被普遍化。

blocks.en: Secondly, all models are adapted with the same LoRA configuration (see Appendix A ). We fixed these values so that differences in performance could be attributed to the base model and the corpus rather than to tuning, and because of hardware constraints. This configuration produces relatively small updates and may underestimate what CPT can achieve for larger and stronger models, so the absence of gains for these models should be read as a property of this setting rather than a theoretical upper bound. We do not evaluate full-parameter training, other LoRA ranks or learning rates, or budgets beyond 60M tokens.
blocks.zh: 第二,所有模型都采用相同的LORA配置(见附录A)进行改造. 我们固定了这些值,以便能将性能的差异归结于基础模型和本体,而不是调和,以及由于硬件的限制. 这种配置产生相对较小的更新,并可能低估CPT对于更大和更强大的模型所能达到的目标,因此这些模型没有收益应该被解读为这种设置的属性,而不是理论上的上限. 我们不评估全参数培训、其他LORA排名或学习率,也不评估超过60兆令牌的预算。

blocks.en: Additionally, our evaluation covers language understanding only. Dialectal adaptation is often motivated by the wish for models that produce the target variety, and our results do not show whether CPT changes the dialectal character of generated text. Evaluating generation, for instance through human judgments of Québec French expressions and constructions in model outputs, is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的评价仅涉及语言理解。  Dialectal reformation 往往是出于对产生目标品种的模型的愿望,我们的结果没有显示CPT是否改变了生成文本的方言特性. 通过人对魁北克法语的表达方式和模型产出的构思来评价一代,是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Finally, while we show that formal literary text drives the acquisition of regional expressions, the exact reason why this occurs has not been investigated in this study. Future work should analyze these literary texts more deeply to understand why they so heavily outperform web data for dialectal adaptation.
blocks.zh: 最后,虽然我们表明,正式的文学文本推动着区域表达方式的获得,但本研究报告没有调查发生这种情况的确切原因。 未来的工作应该更深入地分析这些文学文本,以理解为什么它们如此严重地超过用于方言适应的网络数据.

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented using LoRA with rank r = 32 r=32 , scaling factor α = 64 \alpha=64 , and dropout 0 0 . LoRA is applied to all attention and feed-forward projections ( q q , k k , v v , o o , gate \mathrm{gate} , up \mathrm{up} , and down \mathrm{down} ), while the base-model weights are completely frozen.
blocks.zh: 所有实验均采用R=32 r=32的LORA,缩放系数α=64\alpha=64,辍学 0 0. LoRA应用于所有注意和向导预测(q q, k k , v , o , 闸门\ mathrm{gate}, 上\ mathrm{ up}, 下\ mathrm{ down}) , 而基建模型重量则完全冻结.

blocks.en: We train using the AdamW optimizer with a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 , a peak learning rate of 1 ​ e − 5 1\mathrm{e}{-5} , and a cosine learning rate schedule with a 0.1 0.1 warmup ratio. We apply gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , use a sequence length of 1024 with a stride of 512, and train using mixed precision (fp16) with gradient checkpointing. We reserve 5% of each source for validation and held-out perplexity evaluation; this text is never used for training. At the end of training, we select the final model checkpoint based on the lowest validation loss.
blocks.zh: 我们使用亚当W优化器进行训练,重量衰减为0.01 0.01,峰值学习率为1 e − 5 1\mathrm{e}{5},余弦学习速度表为0.1 0.1热速率. 我们采用1.01.0的梯度剪切法,采用1024的序列长度,步数为512,使用混合精度(fp16)的列车进行梯度检查。 我们保留了每个来源的5%用于验证和搁置的迷惑性评价;这一文本从未用于培训。 在训练结束时,我们根据最低的验证损失选择最终的模型检查站.
